import base64, hashlib, io, json, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise')
archive_path = root / 'private-lab-v2.zip.b64'
receipt_path = root / 'private-lab-v2-verification.json'
data = base64.b64decode(b''.join(archive_path.read_bytes().split()), validate=True)
digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as archive:
    entries = [entry for entry in archive.infolist() if not entry.is_dir()]
    assert len(entries) == 2 and len({entry.filename for entry in entries}) == 2
    members = [{'name': entry.filename, 'bytes': entry.file_size, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read(entry)).hexdigest()} for entry in entries]
result = {'archive': str(archive_path), 'archive_sha256': digest, 'members': members, 'execution_receipt': str(receipt_path), 'exact_archive_hash_present_in_receipt': digest in json.dumps(receipt), 'rights_status': 'The inventory identifies the payloads. Verify the applicable redistribution grant for each member separately.'}
output = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-lemonsqueezy-fit/exact-payload-inventory.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
